name: Yabuki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yabuki town emblem in green: a ring crossed by three horizontal bars with a vertical stroke, like the character 吹.
history: Municipal flag of Yabuki, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Yabuki town emblem — a ring crossed by three horizontal bars with a vertical stroke, like the character 吹
